exposure: Diabetes in Pregnancy Study Group of India (DIPSI) criteria for GDM diagnosis
International Association of Diabetes and Pregnancy Study Groups (IADPSG) criteria for GDM diagnosis
cohort: The study included all antenatal women attending the antenatal clinic at 24-28 weeks of pregnancy.
finding: The sensitivity of DIPSI criteria for diagnosing GDM was found to be quite low, raising questions about its dual use as a screening and diagnostic tool.
